page.layout: One page of running text in a single column. Handwritten annotation "aliud exemplum" in the upper right margin (not printed, so not transcribed). Catchword at lower right, gathering signature at lower left, page number at head.

main_text.l: Aliud exēplū ex L. 2, C. de re-
scind. vendit. Lex est: Re mi-
si nec dimidia pars veri pre-
cij soluta est: hoc est, cum ven-
nia dimidium rei meæ nō va-
let. Veluti, si rem quæ decem
quinq;. Jubet igitur lex, ut em-
sua pecunia: aut justũ suũ pre-

page.notes: Handwritten annotation "aliud exemplum" in the upper right margin, not printed, omitted. A small stray mark "*" beside the line "iuftũ fuũ pre" in the right margin, possibly a reference mark; not transcribed. Header reading and signature "I 2" are uncertain due to faint print and are not marked inline; the running head may read differently. Spelling of u/v, i/j and long s was normalised as instructed; original forms: "ufusfructus", "uĕdita", "fupplere", "uel", "ueri", "uendita", "fi", "fua", "eft", "poteft", "ualet", "Iubet", "iuftũ" (the printed u/v and i/j forms were changed per rule 5).
